fields.name: parent override#If set, this will override all data except for the model during tag post processing
stationary turn fixup speed:degrees per second#higher numbers allow the turn to track a target
ragdoll region name#when the biped transitions to ragdoll, this region will change to the destroyed state
assassination chud text#The string id for the assassination action text in the CHUD
default navpoint name#if set, a navpoint will be placed on this biped with this label on it
maximum soft landing time:seconds#the longest amount of time the biped can take to recover from a soft landing
maximum hard landing time:seconds#the longest amount of time the biped can take to recover from a hard landing
minimum soft landing velocity:world units per second#below this velocity the biped does not react when landing
minimum hard landing velocity:world units per second#below this velocity the biped will not do a soft landing when returning to the ground
maximum hard landing velocity:world units per second#the velocity corresponding to the maximum landing time
stun duration#0 is the default.  Bipeds are stunned when damaged by vehicle collisions, also some are when they take emp damage
slide camera height minimum:world units#minimum height that the camera drops to while sliding
slide camera height function
fields.definition: Use this curve to define how the camera moves while the character is sliding. The x axis covers the course of a full slide. The y axis goes from slide camera minimum height (defined above) to standing height.

fields.name: slide firing delay:seconds#when sliding cannot fire until this number of seconds has passed
camera interpolation start:degrees#looking-downward angle that starts camera interpolation to fp position
camera interpolation end:degrees#looking-downward angle at which camera interpolation to fp position is complete
camera offset:wu#amount of fp camera movement in (forward, right, down) when pitched down by 'camera interpolation end' above
contact points#these are the points where the biped touches the ground
reanimation character#when the flood reanimate this guy, he turns into a ...
death spawn character#when I die, out of the ashes of my death crawls a ...
death particleize#optional particleization effect definition, if you want this to particleize when it dies
Player biped sound bank#Intended for biped vehicles (ie mantis)
Crouch down sound#plays when player starts crouching
Crouch up sound#plays when player stands up
Shield impact override#overrides shield impact sound, like when in a Mantis
Non shield impact override#overrides regular impact sound, like when in a Mantis
Sound radius multiplier#increases radius of other sounds when piloting this biped (mech)
Sound RTPC weight#the weight of this biped in the weighted rtpc functions
Head soft ping, primary response time:seconds#can't be greater than the duration of the unit's soft ping pain screen
Head soft ping, secondary response time:seconds#can't be greater than the duration of the unit's soft ping pain screen
Chest soft ping, primary response time:seconds#can't be greater than the duration of the unit's soft ping pain screen
Chest soft ping, secondary response time:seconds#can't be greater than the duration of the unit's soft ping pain screen
Gut soft ping, primary response time:seconds#can't be greater than the duration of the unit's soft ping pain screen
Gut soft ping, secondary response time:seconds#can't be greater than the duration of the unit's soft ping pain screen
Arms soft ping, primary response time:seconds#can't be greater than the duration of the unit's soft ping pain screen
Arms soft ping, secondary response time:seconds#can't be greater than the duration of the unit's soft ping pain screen
Head soft ping, random twist strength:degrees#set to small, non-zero, value for virtually no twist (ie. 0.01)
Chest soft ping, random twist strength:degrees#set to small, non-zero, value for virtually no twist (ie. 0.01)
Gut soft ping, random twist strength:degrees#set to small, non-zero, value for virtually no twist (ie. 0.01)
Maximum soft ping damage scalar#0.0 = no damage, 1.0 = damage applied by DMG
Override object function for the sprint speed fraction
Biped modifier
fields.definition: Malleable property modifiers for bipeds, independent of tag inheritance

fields.name:
velocity preservation#specifies how pre-trick velocity is maintained during and after the trick
only applies to vehicles

camera interpolation time:s#sloppiness of the camera
only applies to vehicles
trick exit time:s#how long before the end of the trick we start using the below values

trick exit camera interpolation time:s#sloppiness of the camera when exiting the trick
we interpolate between these values depending on how far your camera was displaced from the ideal camera

trick exit displacement reference:wu#when your camera is this far from the ideal at the start of the trick, we use the maximum delay time above
only for space fighter

cooldown time:s#after ending this trick, how long until I can trick again
only applies to vehicles
sliding camera height min:wu#minimum height that the camera drops to while sliding
constant z offset:world units#camera z is modified by this constant z value
living material name#collision material used when character is alive
dead material name#collision material used when character is dead
collision layer override
fields.definition: This value overrides the default, model, and rigid body layer.

fields.name: collision layer override
fields.definition: This value overrides the default collision layer.  It is overridden by any values specified rigid bodies block that overlap. Values set here can be overridden per shape through the shape primitive blocks.

fields.name: brittle timer:seconds#objects in this phantom volume will be set to brittle collision damage for this amount of time.
marker name#you don't need this if you're just generating effects.  If empty it defaults to the up of the object
alignment marker name#you don't need this if you're just generating effects.  If empty it defaults to "marker name"
Linear Motion
fields.definition:
0 - means do nothing
CENTER: motion towards marker position 
AXIS: motion towards marker axis, such that object is on the axis
DIRECTION: motion along marker direction

fields.name: hookes law e#0 if you don't want this to behave like spring.  1 is a good starting point if you do.
linear dead radius#radius from linear motion origin in which acceleration is dead.
orbit acc#negative values spin the opposite direction from positive ones
Angular Motion
fields.definition:
0 - means do nothing
ALIGNMENT: algin objects in the phantom with the marker
SPIN: spin the object about the marker axis

fields.name: alignment hookes law e#0 if you don't want this to behave like spring.  1 is a good starting point if you do.
climb inflection angle#angle for bipeds at which climb direction changes between up and down
scale airborne reaction time#scale on the time for the entity to realize it is airborne
scale ground adhesion velocity#scale on velocity with which the entity is pushed back into its ground plane (set to -1 to lock to ground)
gravity scale#scale on gravity for this entity
airborne acceleration scale#scale on airborne acceleration maximum
successive slide delay:seconds#seconds required to wait after finishing a slide before sliding again
minimum slide trigger sprint fraction:wu/s#character must be moving at least this fast to start sliding
Slide distance function
fields.definition: Determines the distance travelled based on the initial sprint fraction

fields.name: forward speed:wu/s#used to determine a normalized value for the slide distance function
maximum direction change during slide:degrees#maximum amount that the character's direction of travel can turn about the up axis before the slide is aborted
maximum turn during slide:degrees#maximum amount that the character's aim can turn about the up axis before the slide is aborted
Slide speed function
fields.definition: Defines the character's speed over the course of a slide to crouch. 1.0 on the y axis is the speed at which the character entered the slide. 0.0 on the y axis is a full stop.

fields.name: bank angle:degrees#angle at which we bank left/right when sidestepping or turning while moving forwards
bank apply time:seconds#time it takes us to apply a bank
bank decay time:seconds#time it takes us to recover from a bank
pitch ratio#amount that we pitch up/down when moving up or down
max velocity:world units per second#max velocity when not crouching
max sidestep velocity:world units per second#max sideways or up/down velocity when not crouching
angular velocity maximum:degrees per second#turn rate
angular acceleration maximum:degrees per second squared#turn acceleration rate
crouch velocity modifier:[0,1]#how much slower we fly if crouching (zero = same speed)
horizontal range:world units#maximum distance from character to ledge in xy plane
vertical range:world units#maximum distance from top of character's pill to ledge
entry point vertical offset to apex:world units#vertical distance from the ideal entry point to the apex
entry point adjustment benchmark speed:world units/sec#speed used as a benchmark to determine entry point adjustment based on entry speed
entry point horizontal adjustment range:world units#amount that the common entry point can be adjusted horizontally based on entry position and velocity

minimum downward speed required to move entry point down:world units/sec#entry point will not be moved down unless the character is falling at least this fast - prevents downward dip at slow fall speed
entry point vertical adjustment range:world units#amount that the common entry point can be adjusted vertically based on entry position and velocity

initial button press hold time to trigger:seconds#in order to trigger the mobility action with the same button press that triggered the jump, the player must continue to hold the button for this amount of time
minimum forward throttle#throttle must be at least this far forward to trigger the mobility action
maximum ledge slope:degrees#the steepest ledge that can be moved onto by this mobility mode
minimum edge sharpness:degrees#minimum angle between normals of vertical and horizontal faces of ledge
maximum backward reach:world units#maximum distance behind the character of the apex of a path up to a ledge
apex vertical offset:world units#for paths up to a ledge, the vertical offset of the apex from the destination point on the ledge
max exit speed:world units per second#maximum speed at which the character can exit the mobility action
min entry time:seconds#minimum time it can take for the entry phase of the mobility action ("catching the ledge")
max entry time:seconds#maximum time it can take for the entry phase of the mobility action ("catching the ledge")
min movement time:seconds#minimum time it can take to perform the mobility action
max movement time:seconds#maximum time it can take to perform the mobility action
max anchor object relative speed:world units/sec#if an object is moving faster than this relative to us we cannot use it as an anchor for the mobility action
air stabilization interpolation duration:seconds#time it takes to transition into and out of airborne stabilization
air stabilization time scale#slows down time for the character's motion
roll delay:[0,1] 1= roll fast and late
lobbing desire:1= heavy arc, 0= no arc
vaulting fields
fields.definition: The cost of the vault check is scaled by max horizontal distance divided by min object size.  Try to keep that number reasonably low.

fields.name: vault arc amount:1= heavy arc, 0= no arc
search width:wus, the side-to-side width of the search path
ground normal dampening:react to slope changes (0=slow, 1= fast)
root offset max scale idle{root offset max scale}:vertical drop to ground allowed (0=none, 1=full)
root offset max scale moving:vertical drop to ground allowed (0=none, 1=full)
root offset dampening:react to root changes (0=slow, 1= fast)
following cam scale:root offset effect on following cam (0=none, 1=full)
stance width scale:scale pill width to use as stance radius
foot roll max:orient to ground slope (degrees)
foot pitch max:orient to ground slope (degrees)
foot pull threshold distance idle:amount past the authored plane the foot can be pulled (wu)
foot pull threshold distance moving:amount past the authored plane the foot can be pulled (wu)
foot turn minimum radius:minimum radius at which foot is fit to turn radius
foot turn maximum radius:maximum radius at which foot is fit to turn radius
foot turn threshold radius:foot is fit to turn radius fully at minimum plus threshold and above
foot turn weight dampening:dampening of fitting value for fit to turn radius(0=none, 1=fast)
foot turn blend on time:time to blend on the foot turn effect (seconds)
foot turn blend off time:time to blend off the foot turn effect (seconds)
pivot min foot delta: vert world units to find lowest foot
pivot stride length scale: leg length * this = stride length
pivot throttle scale:pivoting slows throttle (0=none, 1= full)
pivot offset dampening:react to pivot changes (0=slow, 1= fast)
pivot force turn rate:turn no matter what the pivot state is (0=control turn, 1= always turn)
ideal pelvis over high foot scale: ratio of pedestal to pelvis distance #ideal ratio of distance from the pelvis to pedestal to place pelvis over the highest foot
ideal pelvis over low foot scale: ratio of pedestal to pelvis distance #ideal ratio of distance from the pelvis to pedestal to place pelvis over the lowest foot
Pushing over Ledges
fields.definition: When a locked foot is unsupported, meaning it can't reach the ground, the biped is considered to be hanging over a ledge. You can provide a velocity that will either push the character over the ledge or away from it

fields.name: push over mag: magnitude of throttle to push over ledges. 0= no push
push back mag: magnitude of throttle to push back from ledges. 0= no push
ledgeIKSuccessRange: when unable to IK at least this close, consider the IK failed.
ledge warning time: secs to warn the player before pushing over a ledge
footlock Scale: (0-1) #how much this biped respects foot lock events
footlock Min Throttle: (0-1) #throttle at which foot lock should be fully on (footlockScale)
footlock Max Throttle: (0-1) #throttle at which foot lock should be fully off
override type#this attachment will override the attachment on the object that shares this
Switch point#value of the function where the sound is triggered
Mode#0 for triggering while function is decreasing, 1 for increasing (more modes to come?)
rotation_node^:bone to rotate to align marker
spine bounds for random posture variation
hand bounds for random posture variation
head bounds for random posture variation
aim fixup cos#0-1, cosine angle of the cone in which aim fixup can occur
aim fixup power#the power curve applied to aim fixup
look yaw scale#0-1, how much we should pivot to match the target direction. recommend 1.0
look non yaw scale#0-1, how much we should tilt or roll to match the target direction. recommend 0.5
look bend scale#0-1, how much we should bend the spine and neck, rather than just rotate the end bone. recommend 0.33
look spine scale#0-1, how much we should adjust the spine rather than the neck. recommend 0.25
look cone angle#degrees, target points are pinned to this code to prevent over-turning the head. recommend 30
max falloff elevation:world units#max jump height for the falloff curves below
Overlay buildup curve
fields.definition: This curve controls the weight of the Overlay while appraching takeoff

fields.name: Overlay falloff curve
fields.definition: This curve controls the weight of the Overlay from Takeoff to Jump Apex

fields.name: Hip IK buildup curve
fields.definition: This curve controls the weight of Hip IK while appraching takeoff

fields.name: Hip IK falloff curve
fields.definition: This curve controls the weight of Hip IK from Takeoff to Jump Apex

fields.name: Leg IK falloff curve
fields.definition: This curve controls the weight of leg IK from Takeoff to Jump Apex

fields.name: bounding radius#If you edit this field manually, beware that the render model is no longer respected for radius calculation and that you need to set the bounding offset as well.
Damage Source
fields.definition:
Damage source name for all damage caused by this object. This includes:
   - collision damage caused by this object
   - melee damage caused by this object (including melee-like special abilities)
   - damage caused by projectiles created by this object
   - damage caused by damage effects created by this object (such as weapon backfiring)

fields.name: only set this tag if you want to override the default collision damage values in globals.globals
melee sound#this is the sound that is made when I am meleed.  This overrides the sweetener sound of my material.
kill on first contact or damage after time:seconds#grace period before object can be instantly killed by kill on first contact or damage flag
self-destruct time:seconds#if non-zero, any instances of this object will destroy themselves after this many seconds.
self-destruct time max:seconds#if non-zero, defines range from which self-destruct time is chosen randomly

simulation_interpolation#Set to a specific interpolation definition, or leave blank to inherit the default for the object type (there are defaults for bipeds, vehicles, and crates in multiplayer_globals).  To disable interpolation on a particular object whose type has interpolation by default, set this reference to the special disable_interpolation.simulation_interpolation tag.
Settings
fields.definition: basic assassinations with this unit as the attacker.

fields.name: assassination weapon stow marker#the anchor we attach the knife to when we stow it
assassination weapon out marker#the anchor we attach the knife to when we pull it out
assassination weapon anchor marker#the marker on the knife that we anchor to the biped
Sequences
fields.definition: sequenced and co-op assassinations with this unit as the victim.

fields.name: soft death direction speed threshold:wu/s#moving faster than this means you will soft death in the movement direction. zero defaults to damage direction.

pain screen duration:seconds|CCBBAA#The duration of the pain function
0 defaults to 0.5
pain screen region fade out duration:seconds|CCBBAA#The time it takes to fade out a damage region that is no longer the most recent damage region to be hit
pain screen region fade out weight threshold:[0,1]#The threshold weight below which the focus channel must fall before we can cross fade to another region.
pain screen angle tolerance:degrees|CCBBAA#The tolerance angle between next and previous damage directions, below which we randomly vary the ping direction.
pain screen angle randomness:degrees|CCBBAA#The maximum random angle to vary the incoming ping direction by if it's too close to the previous ping.

defensive screen duration:seconds#The duration of the defensive function
0 defaults to 2.0
defensive screen scrub fallback fraction:[0,1]#When receiving multiple pings, this is the min percentage of the defensive screen scrub value will fallback to.
distance of dive anim:world units#this must be set to tell the AI how far it should expect our dive animation to move us
terminal velocity fall ratio#ratio of airborne_arc animation to switch off falling overlay
stun movement penalty:[0,1]#1.0 prevents moving while stunned
stun turning penalty:[0,1]#1.0 prevents turning while stunned
stun jumping penalty:[0,1]#1.0 prevents jumping while stunned
minimum stun time:seconds#all stunning damage will last for at least this long
maximum stun time:seconds#no stunning damage will last for longer than this
spawned turret character#automatically created character when this unit is driven
spawned actor count#number of actors which we spawn
spawned velocity#velocity at which we throw spawned actors

target aiming pivot marker name#set this to have your weapon barrel point at its calculated target instead of matching the aiming of the unit controlling it.  This marker should be along the barrel at point that doesn't move when the barrel pitches up and down.
aiming acceleration maximum:degrees per second squared
looking acceleration maximum:degrees per second squared
object velocity maximum!:world units per second#Debug value for object velocity that corresponds to a blend screen weight of 1, 0 defaults to 5.0
right_hand_node#where the primary weapon is attached
left_hand_node#where the secondary weapon is attached (for dual-pistol modes)
native melee override#when set, characters will melee with these settings rather than their actual held weapon. (for characters that melee with an off hand)
motion tracker range modifier#if the player is in a seat in this unit then modify the motion tracker range by this amount (see base value in player globals tag for how this modifier is applied)
maximum seat switch linear velocity#How fast the vehicle can be going and still allow a seat switch
maximum seat switch angular velocity#How fast the vehicle can be tumbling and still allow a seat switch

opening time:s#how long the unit takes to open when the hs_function unit_open is called
The current open state can be retrieved from the object function unit_open
closing time:s#you don't have to go home, but you can't stay here
emp disabled time (PVP):seconds #Set to -1 for not disabled in MP but disabled in SP
Vehicle Death Telemetry Rule
fields.definition: ONLY USED FOR UNITS THAT ARE TREATED AS VEHICLES. Defines the circumstances under which we send telemetry events for this unit's death. If you don't know what this means, talk to the engineer that owns the damage system. Don't touch it if you don't know what you're doing!

fields.name: bailout threshold:wu/s#the speed above which units will bail out of a vehicle instead of just exiting
iron sight weapon dampening:(0-1)#when using iron sights, how much to scale the weapon overlays to steady the gun (0 = rock steady, 1= no dampening)

options: has physical rigid bodies when alive
sync action always projects on ground
aim driven orientation in stationary turns
conservatively ragdoll as fallback#if the death program doesn't explicitly specify otherwise, fallback to conservatively engaging ragdoll

trick relative#velocity is relative to the object's orientation at the start of the trick (so if you're moving forward before the trick, you will be moving forward after the trick, even if that's a different direction)
world relative#velocity is maintained in world space

use following camera#as opposed to the trick camera, which is the default
vehicles only
do not slam player control#allows the player to continue to move aiming vector while tricking
force enable collision with player#enables collision with the player regardless of the collision group
allow feet below grade#normally, we will force the feet to lock to the ground surface
use biped up direction#instead of world-up. For characters that climb walls
snap marker above contact#prevents ground marker from going below the contact point
allow ball-roll on foot when idle#prevents foot-ik from settling
force always on#when this flag is clear we only create the attachment when the function object function is active or set to empty string
effect size scale from object scale
sequential#applies the percentages one after another on the base
total percentage#adds up all of the percentages and applies them to the base
addition#adds on all of the modifiers to the base
product#multiplies the values one after another on to the base
